colors.archetype: Soft Utility mixed with Vibrant Play
colors.tailwind_config_instructions: Modify index.css :root variables. Set --primary to 262 83% 58% (Hex #7C3AED). Set --background to 0 0% 98%. Adjust dark mode --background to 0 0% 4%. Never use pure black or pure white; always tint with purple. Ensure colors are defined properly for Shadcn compatibility.

rules.contrast: Always ensure > 4.5:1 ratio for normal text. Hover states must explicitly set text color and lighten/darken the background.
rules.accents: Use vivid purple primarily for CTAs, active states, and small brand accents. Do not overload with full-screen gradients.

surfaces.header: Crystal Glass: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 (light) or bg-black/60 (dark) with 1px border-white/20.
surfaces.cards: Flat background, subtle 1px border-border, max 12px border radius. Hover states: -translate-y-1, shadow-lg.

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (opacity 2-3%) to avoid digital flatness.

layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-6, p-8 inside cards to avoid text collision. Use gap-6 or gap-8 in grids.
layouts.dashboard: Bento Grid Protocol (High Density). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Gap-6.
layouts.navigation: Sticky top nav (Crystal Glass) with small Logo (NOI DI 2D) without background + primary links. Visible on desktop, hamburger on mobile.

motion.p2p_actions: Framer Motion is REQUIRED for P2P 'Throwing' actions. Create a custom hook/component to animate throwing a paper plane, water bucket, or pizza slice across the screen using animate().
motion.micro_interactions: Hover states must lift cards (-translate-y-1) and deepen shadows. Buttons must scale down (scale-95) on active/click.
motion.page_transitions: Staggered fade-in for list items and dashboard cards using framer-motion.

components_instructions.buttons: Pill-shaped or rounded-lg. No generic styles. Use active animations.
components_instructions.forms: Use Shadcn components. Do not use native <input>. Customize Shadcn with brand colors.
components_instructions.tables_lists: Shadcn tables. Left-align text. Add subtle hover states on rows.
components_instructions.ai_study_chat: Use Shadcn Tabs to switch between Flashcards, Upload, and Quiz. Chat needs distinct bubble styling (purple for self, gray for others).
components_instructions.toast: Use Sonner for P2P action notifications and event signups. (Located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js)

accessibility.data_testid: ALL interactive elements must include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., event-signup-button, throw-pizza-button).

media.image_handling: Mobile max-h-[80vh]. Never fully cover hero images; use bg-black/40 max. Images must have explicit alt text.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Use framer-motion for the P2P throwing animations instead of pure 3D to keep performance high and maintain the modern minimalist feel.

study_group.description: High school students studying together, use for AI Study Aid section background or card.

auditorium_events.description: Empty auditorium, use for Events Registration page banner.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You are building a React application using .js/.jsx files. DO NOT use .tsx or TypeScript syntax.
NEVER create generic centered layouts. Use asymmetrical or balanced Bento Grids.
NEVER use generic fonts like Inter or Roboto for Headings. Use the recommended Cabinet Grotesk, Outfit, or Manrope.
DO NOT use placeholder image URLs. Only use the provided image URLs or lucide-react icons.
NO emoji characters in the UI for icons, use lucide-react or custom SVG.
The app must be a PWA. Provide a 'Guida installazione PWA' (PWA installation guide) in the UI or Settings.
Theme: Modern Minimalist with Purple Accents. Implement a Dark/Light mode toggle.
Italian Language required for all UI text ('NOI DI 2D', 'Iscrizioni', 'Aiuto Studio', 'Chat Pubblica', 'Pannello Admin').
P2P Actions (Foglietto, Secchio, Pizza) should overlay via absolute/fixed positioning over the viewport, animated with Framer Motion when triggered.
Chat feature requires automatic censorship logic (can be a simple regex/array of blocked words replacement with ***).
Do not put transparent backgrounds behind text if there's an image underneath. Always use Crystal Glass or solid colors.
All interactive elements must include a data-testid attribute.
